competition.title: Robo - War
competition.details:
Robo-War 2026 – Combat Robotics Competition

Get ready for an intense battle of robotics, engineering, strategy and control!

Robo-War 2026 is a combat-robotics competition organized as part of HIMOVATION 2026, the Annual National Technical Festival of the School of Science & Technology (SST), Swami Rama Himalayan University (SRHU), Dehradun.

The competition challenges teams to design, build and operate remote-controlled combat robots inside a protected arena. Participants will put their skills in mechanical design, electronics, control systems, robotics and engineering strategy to the test.

Event Details:

  • Event: Robo-War 2026
  • Date: 27–28 November 2026
  • Mode: Offline / On-Campus
  • Venue: School of Science & Technology (SST), Swami Rama Himalayan University, Dehradun
  • Team Size: 2–3 members
  • Registration Fee: ₹500 per team
  • Expected Participation: 20–25 teams
  • Prize Pool: ₹37,000

Prize Pool:

  • 1st Prize: ₹21,000

  • 2nd Prize: ₹11,000

  • 3rd Prize: ₹5,000

Certificates of Achievement will also be provided as per the event criteria.

Who Can Participate?

The competition is open to:

  • Students and eligible robotics enthusiasts as permitted by the organizers.
  • Participants interested in robotics, electronics, mechanical systems, embedded systems and remote-control technologies.
  • Teams must consist of 2 to 3 members.
  • Each team must nominate one Team Leader.
  • Only registered team members will be permitted to represent the team during the competition.

️Competition Format:

  • The competition will follow a knockout and/or league format, depending on the final number of participating teams.
  • The competition will be conducted in a designated protected combat arena under the supervision of referees/judges.
  • The broad flow will be:
  • Registration → Technical Verification → Safety Inspection → Qualifying/League or Knockout Rounds → Advanced Rounds → Final → Winner Declaration
  • The final match schedule and detailed operational rules will be communicated by the organizing committee before the competition
Robot Requirements:

Participants must ensure that:

  • The robot is remotely controlled.
  • The robot is designed for safe operation inside the designated combat arena.
  • The robot does not create unnecessary danger to participants, officials or spectators.
  • Teams bring all necessary equipment required for operating their robot.
  • The robot successfully passes the technical and safety inspection before participation.
  • The organizing committee reserves the right to reject any robot considered unsafe.

The competition include weight-category classes, subject to the final event configuration

️Safety Rules:

Safety is a mandatory part of Robo-War.

Participants must:

  • Follow all instructions issued by referees and safety officials.
  • Remain outside the designated safety barricade during matches.
  • Not enter the combat arena without authorization.
  • Ensure that only authorized team members operate the robot.
  • Switch off or make the robot safe whenever it is not participating in a match.
  • Follow all fire-safety and emergency procedures announced by the organizers.

Any unsafe operation may result in immediate suspension or disqualification.

️ Match Rules:

  • Teams must report to the arena before their scheduled match.
  • Late arrival may result in a walkover.
  • All matches will be conducted under the supervision of referees/judges.
  • Teams must immediately stop their robot whenever instructed by the referee.
  • Deliberate attempts to damage the arena or violate safety rules may result in disqualification.
  • The referee's decision during a match shall be final.
Evaluation & Winning Criteria:

Teams may be evaluated on:

  • Technical Design
  • Mechanical Robustness
  • Control & Maneuverability
  • Strategy
  • Effective Performance During Matches
  • Compliance with Safety Requirements

The final result will be determined by the designated judges/referees in accordance with the competition rules.

Registration:

  • Registration Fee: ₹500 per team
  • Registration must be completed within the prescribed registration timeline.
  • Teams must provide accurate participant details.
  • Technical details of the robot may be required during verification.
  • Registration is considered confirmed only after successful verification and completion of the applicable registration process.
  • Any change in team composition after registration requires approval from the organizing committee.

Important Rules & Conduct:

  • Participants must maintain discipline and professional conduct throughout the event.
  • Cheating, unfair practices, misconduct or violation of safety regulations may result in disqualification.
  • Participants must respect fellow participants, judges, referees, volunteers and organizers.
  • Participants must follow all University campus rules and safety instructions.
  • Participants are responsible for their own equipment and belongings unless otherwise specified by the organizers.
  • The organizing committee may modify the schedule, format or arrangements if required due to operational or unforeseen circumstances.
  • The decision of the judges and organizing committee shall be final and binding.

Why Participate?

  • Put your engineering skills to the ultimate test.

Design. Control. Strategize. Compete.

Robo-War 2026 is an opportunity for robotics enthusiasts to experience competitive combat robotics in a structured on-campus environment while demonstrating their skills in mechanical engineering, electronics, embedded systems, remote control and strategic thinking.

Organized By:

  • School of Science & Technology (SST)
  • Swami Rama Himalayan University (SRHU), Dehradun

Event Contact:

  • Dr. Rohit Kanauzia – 8126207090
  • Dr. Gunjan Chhabra – 8433102140
  • Dr. Ashutosh Bhatt – 7895533079

Email: himovation@srhu.edu.in

️Note:

Detailed technical specifications, final weight categories, match schedules and any additional competition rules will be communicated by the organizing committee before the event. Participants must comply with the final rules issued by the organizers.

details.title: Round 1: Online Registration & Robot Screening
details.display_text:
Mode: Online
Fee: FREE
Date: Registration/Screening Round

Participants will register their team online and submit the required details of their proposed/available combat robot for preliminary screening.

Participants will be required to provide:

  • Team details and participant information

  • Team Leader details

  • Robot name

  • Robot technical specifications

  • Robot dimensions and relevant design details

  • Control/operation details

  • Other technical information requested in the registration form

The submitted robot details will be reviewed by the organizing team for eligibility and compliance with the basic competition requirements.

Important: There is no registration fee for Round 1.

Only teams shortlisted after the online screening will be invited to participate in the final offline Robo-War competition.

details.title: Round 2: Offline Robo-War Competition – Final Round
details.display_text:
Mode: Offline / On-Campus
Date: 27 November 2026
Venue: School of Science & Technology (SST), Swami Rama Himalayan University, Dehradun


Shortlisted teams will participate in the final Robo-War combat competition at the SRHU campus. Before entering the competition, participating robots will undergo the required technical and safety verification. The competition will then proceed through the designated match format, which may include qualifying/knockout or league rounds, depending on the final number of participating teams. Teams will compete under referee supervision inside the designated Robo-War arena.

Round-2 Registration:

Only shortlisted teams from Round 1 will be required to pay the ₹500 team registration fee to confirm their participation in the offline competition.

Round 1 → Free Online Registration & Robot Screening: Shortlisting

Round 2 → ₹500 Fee + Offline Robo-War Competition: Final Matches & Winner Declaration
